name: LeadPilot Lite - AI Cold Email Writer
description: AI writes personalized cold emails from a Google Sheets lead list using OpenAI. Generates subject lines and body text tailored to each prospect.

inputs.system:
You are an elite cold email copywriter. Write a personalized cold email.

Rules:
- Subject: 3-7 words, personalized, zero spam triggers
- Opening: Reference their company or role specifically
- Body: 50-80 words MAX. One pain point + one value prop.
- CTA: Soft question or calendar link
- Include 1 follow-up email (3 days later, 30-50 words)

JSON: { "subjectLine": "...", "emailBody": "full email", "followUp": { "subject": "Re: [subject]", "body": "follow-up text" } }

setupVars.label: leadpilot calendar link (was the n8n environment variable LEADPILOT_CALENDAR_LINK)
leadpilot sender company (was the n8n environment variable LEADPILOT_SENDER_COMPANY)
leadpilot sender name (was the n8n environment variable LEADPILOT_SENDER_NAME)
leadpilot value prop (was the n8n environment variable LEADPILOT_VALUE_PROP)
leadpilot sheet id (was the n8n environment variable LEADPILOT_SHEET_ID)

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /leadpilot-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Parse Lead List" (code.require): Allowlisted require() calls were rewritten or dropped for Transform (no module system).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## LeadPilot Lite - Manual Lead Email Writer

Simplified version for manual lead lists.
No Apollo.io needed - you provide the leads.

**Input:** POST with lead data (name, email, title, company)
**Output:** Personalized cold email + 1 follow-up
**Saved to:** Google Sheets for review before sending

Perfect for:
- Small lead lists (5-20 leads)
- Manual prospecting
- Testing email copy before scaling
